quote.text: There is nothing more deceptive than an obvious fact.
quote.author: Sherlock Holmes, in Arthur Conan Doyle’s The Boscombe Valley Mystery, 1891

stories.headline: Prabowo sacks chief of staff Listyo Sigit, arrested over wiretapping the president
stories.dek: Police seized eleven phones, an iPad and four flash drives, and questioned ten witnesses. A day later the army moved more than 20,000 soldiers into Jakarta.

stories.headline: Singapore’s Parliament raises the maximum haze fine tenfold to twenty million dollars
stories.dek: Grace Fu took the bill through all three readings in one sitting under a Certificate of Urgency. In twelve years the original Act has produced no prosecution.

stories.headline: Mirziyoyev signs PP-294 after Uzbekistan’s central bank measured credit at 66.5 per cent
stories.dek: Presidential resolution PP-294, signed on 14 August, drags instalment operators into a register from 1 January 2027. Household bank debt reached 243.6 trillion soum on 1 September.

stories.headline: Feuerhand and Dietz lanterns make the same seven candlepower at twice the price
stories.dek: W.T. Kirkman’s own catalogue rates both at 7 candlepower on a half-inch wick. The extra $21 buys galvanised steel, a Schott globe and nine more hours.

stories.headline: Lisa Su reports a record $13.4bn quarter at AMD and guides to $17bn
stories.dek: Lisa Su told analysts on 3 November that revenue should grow more than 80 per cent in 2027, with server revenue doubling; data-centre sales nearly doubled to $8.5bn.

stories.headline: Engadget scores Dell’s $999 Googlebook 6.5 and recommends the Windows version
stories.dek: Devindra Hardawar measured 15 hours 15 minutes of battery on 2 November, and found one app draining half the charge while idle in the background.

stories.kicker: The Good Life · Audio-Technica’s Wooden Flagship
stories.headline: Audio-Technica prices its Kiso-cypress flagship headphone at 3,799 US dollars
stories.dek: It debuted at the Paris Audio Video Show on 23 October and now sits above the firm’s own open-backed model at $3,499 — the sealed one is the dearer.

stories.kicker: Screen & Sound · The Black Parade At Twenty
stories.headline: My Chemical Romance tops the Billboard 200 twenty years after The Black Parade
stories.dek: Luminate counted 78,000 equivalent album units on the Billboard chart dated 7 November, up 653 per cent, as the reissue jumped from No. 139 to No. 1.

stories.kicker: The Family Desk · The Ten O’Clock Line
stories.headline: JAMA Pediatrics links late-night phone use to twenty minutes less teenage sleep
stories.dek: The study tracked 425 adolescents of mean age 14.8 across 7,591 nights of Fitbit sleep and phone-logged use, and reports confidence intervals throughout.

stories.kicker: The Macro Desk · The War Premium Deflating
stories.headline: Democrats win both chambers, and traders cut Brent eight per cent to $95
stories.dek: Brent settled near $95.06 on 4 November after $113.39 on 30 October , sixteen per cent off in three sessions, while gold rose 3.4 per cent and the US ten-year fell five basis points.

stories.headline: Elsa Soo of Singapore, aged 60, finished fifth in the world at Turku
stories.dek: The Singapore Kennel Club has run 79 trials under international rules and 215 under its own. One May trial produced three qualifying rounds out of thirty-one.

stories.headline: Copenhagen’s Fabian Finger finds an antioxidant worsened muscle loss in mice
stories.dek: Fabian Finger’s Nature Aging paper of 29 September restored one mitochondrial fat from 27 to 67 per cent of normal and reversed the wasting.

stories.kicker: The Diary · A Second Night Added
stories.headline: Kenshi Yonezu adds a second Singapore night on 30 January
stories.dek: The extra date went up on 22 October, and Singapore is the GHOST tour’s only South-East Asian stop. In Tokyo, a centenary Orsay show opens 14 November with every visitor under 18 free.
